name: Safe House
source:
Safe House tells the story of a zombie virus sweeping the world, turning most humans into irrational monsters. The male protagonist Xin and the family of other safe houses will find the truth buried and a way to survive under the threat of zombie and other survivor forces.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707580/Safe_House/]Steam[/url]]
